questions.stem: Which type of relationship is described when one organism benefits and the other is not affected?
questions.solution: Commensalism is the correct answer because it describes a relationship where one organism benefits and the other is neither helped nor harmed. Parasitism involves one organism benefiting while the other is harmed, mutualism involves both organisms benefiting, and competition refers to a struggle for resources, not a type of biological relationship.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a reason why the Sundarbans are considered a World Heritage Site?
choices: They have the largest mangrove forests in the world
They are home to many endangered species
They are the only mangrove forest in the world that is not threatened by climate change
They absorb carbon dioxide from the air and release oxygen
questions.solution: The Sundarbans are considered a World Heritage Site because they contain the largest mangrove forests in the world, which is a unique and ecologically significant feature. While they are home to many endangered species and play a role in carbon absorption, these are not the primary reason for their heritage status. The claim that they are not threatened by climate change is false, as mangrove ecosystems worldwide face significant climate-related challenges.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a biotic component of an ecosystem?
questions.solution: The correct answer is plants because they are living organisms, making them biotic components. Air, water, and soil are non-living and therefore abiotic components.

questions.stem: Which of the following is an example of a biotic component in a habitat?
questions.solution: Trees are living organisms and therefore are considered biotic components of a habitat. Soil and water are non-living, making them abiotic components. Sunlight is also non-living and not a component of the habitat itself.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a characteristic of a producer in an ecosystem?
choices: They depend on other organisms for food
They break down complex substances into simple ones
They make their own food through photosynthesis
They feed on both plants and animals
questions.solution: Producers, like plants, make their own food through the process of photosynthesis. This is why they are called autotrophs. The other options describe consumers or decomposers, not producers.

questions.stem: What happens if a habitat has only one type of living organism?
choices: They will all thrive and grow
questions.solution: If a habitat has only one type of living organism, they will compete for resources because all individuals have identical needs for food, water, and space. This competition can lead to resource depletion and instability in the population. Other options are incorrect because a single species cannot form a community, and while extinction is possible, it is not guaranteed.

hi.stem: एक आवास में केवल एक प्रकार के जीवित जीव होने पर क्या होता है?
choices: वे सभी उत्तम रूप से बढ़ेंगे और बढ़ेंगे
वे संसाधनों के लिए प्रतिस्पर्धा करेंगे
hi.solution: यदि एक आवास में केवल एक प्रकार के जीवित जीव होते हैं, तो वे संसाधनों के लिए प्रतिस्पर्धा करेंगे क्योंकि सभी व्यक्तियों के भोजन, पानी और जगह की आवश्यकता एक ही होती है। इस प्रतिस्पर्धा के कारण संसाधनों का उपभोग हो सकता है और आबादी में अस्थिरता आ सकती है। अन्य विकल्प गलत हैं क्योंकि एक ही प्रजाति एक समुदाय नहीं बना सकती है, और यद्यपि विलुप्त होना संभव है, यह आवश्यक नहीं है।
hi.critique: Translation is accurate, maintains original meaning, and uses appropriate Hindi scientific terminology.

questions.stem: What happens if the number of frogs in an ecosystem decreases due to overharvesting?
questions.solution: If the number of frogs decreases, their role as predators of insects is reduced, leading to an increase in insect populations. Fish population would not increase because frogs contribute to the ecosystem's balance, and oxygen production is not directly affected by frog numbers. Pesticide use would increase, not decrease, due to the rise in insect pests.

questions.stem: If a farmer wants to reduce the use of synthetic fertilisers, which of the following practices should they adopt?
choices: Planting a single type of crop in the same area each year
Using organic manure like Kunapa Jala
questions.solution: Using organic manure like Kunapa Jala provides essential nutrients to the soil without the need for synthetic fertilisers, making it an effective alternative. Planting a single crop repeatedly and using more pesticides can deplete soil nutrients and harm the environment, increasing reliance on synthetic inputs. The correct option is the second one.

questions.stem: What would happen if all decomposers suddenly disappeared from a forest ecosystem?
choices: The population of producers would increase
The population of consumers would increase
The nutrients in the soil would become scarce
The number of predators would decrease
questions.solution: If decomposers disappeared, dead matter would not be broken down, leading to a scarcity of nutrients in the soil. This would affect the growth of producers, who rely on these nutrients. The other options are incorrect because they do not directly result from the absence of decomposers. Producers would not thrive without nutrients, and consumers would not increase due to the lack of available food.

hi.stem: यदि एक वन पारिस्थितिक तंत्र से सभी विघटक अचानक लुप्त हो गए, तो क्या होगा?
choices: मिट्टी में पोषक तत्व कम हो जाएंगे
कुछ शिकारियों की संख्या कम हो जाएगी
hi.solution: यदि विघटक लुप्त हो जाएं, तो मृत पदार्थ अपघटित नहीं होंगे, जिसके परिणामस्वरूप मिट्टी में पोषक तत्व कम हो जाएंगे। इससे उत्पादकों के विकास पर प्रभाव पड़ेगा, जो इन पोषक तत्वों पर निर्भर करते हैं। अन्य विकल्प गलत हैं क्योंकि वे विघटकों की अनुपस्थिति से सीधे परिणाम नहीं हैं। बिना पोषक तत्वों के उत्पादक अच्छी तरह से विकसित नहीं हो सकते हैं, और खाद्य सामग्री के अभाव में उपभोक्ताओं की संख्या बढ़ नहीं सकती।
hi.critique: The translation is accurate, maintains the original meaning, and uses appropriate Hindi terminology for ecological concepts.

questions.stem: In a food chain, which of the following is a producer?
questions.solution: Grass is a producer because it makes its own food through photosynthesis. Hare and mouse are consumers, and mushroom is a decomposer. Producers are organisms that can create their own food, which is the first trophic level in a food chain.

hi.stem: एक खाद्य श्रृंखला में, निम्नलिखित में से कौन एक उत्पादक है?
hi.solution: घास एक उत्पादक है क्योंकि यह प्रकाश संश्लेषण द्वारा अपना खाना बनाता है। खरगोश और चूहा उपभोक्ता हैं, और कांटा एक वियोजक है। उत्पादक वे जीव होते हैं जो अपना खाना बना सकते हैं, जो खाद्य श्रृंखला में पहला पोषण स्तर होता है।
hi.critique: The translation is accurate, maintains the original meaning, and uses appropriate Hindi terminology for biological concepts.

mr.stem: खाद्य प्रसारात, खालीलपैकी कोण उत्पादक आहे?
mr.solution: लालसर उत्पादक आहे कारण ते स्वतःचे खाद्य फोटोसंश्लेषणाद्वारे तयार करते. खरगोश आणि चूहा उपभोक्ते आहेत, आणि कॅप्सूल विघटक आहे. उत्पादक म्हणजे जीव जे स्वतःचे खाद्य तयार करू शकतात, जे खाद्य प्रसारात पहिल्या पोषण स्तरावर असतात.

questions.stem: In a food web, how many organisms can a single organism be connected to through feeding relationships?
questions.solution: In a food web, a single organism can be connected to two or more organisms through feeding relationships. This shows that food chains are interlinked, forming a complex network. The idea of multiple connections is key to understanding the structure of a food web.
